title: ECDSA sign/verify serialized through single global mutex
description: Scenario: TLS server with N concurrent handshakes all requiring ECDSA operations. All DO_SIGN and DO_VERIFY ioctls serialize through g_ecdsa_fd_lock on g_crypto2dev_fd. N=8 concurrent ECDSA ops queue sequentially behind this lock. The comment at port.c:205-211 documents this and describes the fix (pool ECDSA fds once DO_SIGN on non-global fds is validated). Maintenance consequence: users running production TLS servers will file throughput bugs blaming wolfSSL or the kernel driver; the bottleneck is actually the single-fd serialization in this port. Needs to become a tracked issue rather than just a comment.
